title: Search file contents
description: Search the workspace for a regular expression and return matching lines with their file and line number. Narrow with `glob` (e.g. "src/**/*.ts"). Results are capped; refine the pattern rather than raising the cap. Use the glob tool to search file NAMES.

pattern.description: Regular expression (JavaScript syntax) to search for.

glob.description: Optional path pattern limiting which files are searched, e.g. "src/**/*.js".

limit.description: Maximum matching lines to return (default 50, max 200).

examples: find every TODO in the source
